findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_connection_health · Private data: list_products, get_portfolio_pulse, get_agents, get_connection_health, scan_agent_commerce_readiness, get_evidence · Public sink: get_connection_health · Destructive: validate_installation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_connection_health · Private data: list_products, get_portfolio_pulse, get_agents, get_connection_health, scan_agent_commerce_readiness, get_evidence · Public sink: get_connection_health · Destructive: validate_installation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
